Keep the maintained upstream bundle API. Add only zipExactReviewBundle so consumer proof can emit the two-file manifest.json + review/<pr>.md zip. Do not restrict the default rail to review-only files.
Keep native report identity checks and add required comprehensive epoch/actor fields plus the engine-authored Bound Review Identity section.

consumer_pin.adaptation: Hash pin and explicit supplied-checkout proof only. The producer does not vendor or reimplement parse_clawsweeper_bundle, and standard tests stay portable.
